briefings.title: Episode 48: Dmitry Balyasny - Managing Partner and CIO of Balyasny Asset Management
briefings.tldr: Dmitry Balyasny, Founder and CIO of Balyasny Asset Management (BAM), discusses his journey from an immigrant to building a leading $30B multi-strategy hedge fund, emphasizing a disciplined business model, partnership culture, continuous talent development, and adaptable edge to generate consistent returns across market cycles.
